name: Sequential dungeon layout
operation_language: Authoring declarations only; not registered engine opcodes.

authored_operations.direction: shuffle four cardinal directions; choose first; advance in this direction for every later room

intermediate_distribution.pool: dungeon.monster_pool; pick with replacement; duplicates retain weight

authored_operations.tactical_override: An intermediate room with tactical_rooms[str(i)] becomes EMPTY; clear generated monsters, loot and event. Its authored local room owns encounter/objects.
authored_operations.final_room: BOSS, id room_count-1, dungeon.boss.monster_id only; preserve configuration separately.

blockers: Generation code selects boss monster_id only. Campaign bonus_hp/name and event_table fields are not automatically consumed by this generator. No rolled layout is a hand-authored permanent dungeon map.
